```{=html}
<style>
/* Slogan 绝对定位，具体坐标由 JS 动态计算 */
#snowy-slogan {
  position: fixed;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  z-index: 1000;
  text-align: center;
  pointer-events: none; /* 防止文字框阻挡下方的鼠标点击事件 */
  background: rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.1); /* 加一点极淡的背景框提升辨识度 */
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease, visibility 0.5s ease, left 0.3s ease, top 0.3s ease;
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  #snowy-slogan { font-size: 0.8em; }
}

/* 暗黑模式下的显示与隐藏逻辑 (兼容 Quarto 与 Bootstrap 新规范) */
body.quarto-dark #snowy-slogan,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] #snowy-slogan {
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
}
</style>

<div id="snowy-slogan">
  <i>Try switching to <b>Dark Mode</b></i>
</div>

<script>
  // 动态寻找主题切换按钮，并将 Slogan 绑定在它的正下方
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const slogan = document.getElementById('snowy-slogan');
    if (!slogan) return;

    const sloganSeenKey = 'yuki-slogan-seen';

    // 1. 检查是否需要显示 Slogan
    // 如果用户已经看过，或者初始主题就是暗色，则永久隐藏
    const isInitiallyDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-bs-theme') === 'dark' || document.body.classList.contains('quarto-dark');
    if (localStorage.getItem(sloganSeenKey) || isInitiallyDark) {
      slogan.style.display = 'none';
      // 如果是首次访问且为暗色主题，则记录下来
      if (isInitiallyDark && !localStorage.getItem(sloganSeenKey)) {
        localStorage.setItem(sloganSeenKey, 'true');
      }
      return; // 直接退出，不执行后续的定位和监听逻辑
    }

    // 2. 如果需要显示，则设置监听器，在用户切换到暗色时记录状态
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-bs-theme') === 'dark' || document.body.classList.contains('quarto-dark');
      if (isDark) {
        localStorage.setItem(sloganSeenKey, 'true');
        // 修复：等待 0.5 秒 CSS 渐隐动画结束后，将其彻底从图层隐藏。
        // 这样即使用户在不刷新页面的情况下切回亮色，它也绝对不会再出现了。
        setTimeout(() => {
          slogan.style.display = 'none';
        }, 500);
        observer.disconnect(); // 任务完成，停止监听
      }
    });
    observer.observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-bs-theme', 'class'] });
    observer.observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });

    // 3. Slogan 定位逻辑 (仅在需要显示时执行)
    const navbar = document.querySelector('.navbar');
    const toggleBtn = document.querySelector('.quarto-color-scheme-toggle');

    if (slogan.parentElement !== document.body) {
      document.body.appendChild(slogan);
    }

    const updateSloganPos = () => {
      if (toggleBtn && toggleBtn.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0) {
        const btnRect = toggleBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
        const navBottom = navbar ? navbar.getBoundingClientRect().bottom : btnRect.bottom;
        slogan.style.top = (navBottom + 10) + 'px';
        let leftPos = btnRect.left + (btnRect.width / 2) - (slogan.offsetWidth / 2);
        if (leftPos < 10) leftPos = 10;
        if (leftPos + slogan.offsetWidth > window.innerWidth - 10) {
          leftPos = window.innerWidth - slogan.offsetWidth - 10;
        }
        slogan.style.left = leftPos + 'px';
        slogan.style.right = 'auto';
      } else if (navbar) {
        const navRect = navbar.getBoundingClientRect();
        slogan.style.top = (navRect.bottom + 10) + 'px';
        slogan.style.right = '15px';
        slogan.style.left = 'auto';
      }
    };
    
    setTimeout(updateSloganPos, 100);
    setTimeout(updateSloganPos, 500);
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateSloganPos);
  });
</script>
```
